title: A playing video floats while its note is out of sight
steps: Open Floating video and play the video. Then ⌘-click another note in the sidebar to open it in a new tab: the video floats in a small window in the bottom right, still playing, named with its note. Drag it by its bar.
Press ↩ (Back to note): the note's tab shows, and the video docks back in place, still playing.
Scroll down until the video is out of view: it floats. Scroll back: it docks.
While it plays, close the note's tab: it keeps floating. ↩ opens the note again, and it docks, without restarting.
✕ pauses it and closes the window. The mini player (bottom right) can play it again.
Play the Spotify track, then open another tab: it plays on unseen, and the mini player names it with a link back to its note. Pause it there, or with the keyboard's media keys.
In settings, "media.whenHidden": "pause" pauses whatever plays when its note goes out of sight, and "keepPlaying" plays on unseen, without floating.
